description: Non-social testbed: a balanced 100-task pinned BFCL v4 subset crossed with 96 Latin-hypercube four-dimensional tool-policy profiles.

dimensions.name: action_propensity
dimensions.prompt_negative: use a high action threshold: abstain rather than call a tool when the request is irrelevant or materially underspecified
dimensions.prompt_positive: use a low action threshold: call an applicable tool whenever the user's likely requested action is sufficiently clear

dimensions.name: intent_interpretation
dimensions.prompt_negative: interpret requests literally and avoid extending beyond their explicitly stated intent
dimensions.prompt_positive: infer implicit intent from the full request and tool descriptions when the intended operation is reasonably clear

dimensions.name: argument_policy
dimensions.prompt_negative: supply only arguments explicitly supported by the request; do not invent missing values
dimensions.prompt_positive: use schema defaults and strongly implied values when doing so is necessary to complete the requested operation

dimensions.name: orchestration_policy
dimensions.prompt_negative: prefer minimal atomic invocation and avoid unnecessary batching
dimensions.prompt_positive: emit all independent required calls together and use parallel orchestration when the request contains multiple operations
